name: Baraza Coffee
tagline: Pakistan's largest specialty coffee brew bar
description: Specialty coffee, kitchen and bakes. Single-origin beans from Ethiopia, Colombia and Kenya, pulled on La Marzocco.

categoryNotes.Specialty Coffee: Double shots pulled with precision on La Marzocco.
categoryNotes.Chillers: 24-hour slow-steeped cold brew, nitro float, and flash-chilled iced creations.
categoryNotes.Kitchen: House-baked pastries, smashed avocado toast, and seasonal small plates.
